query: What happens when Apple iPhone 7 buyers contact the seller or manufacturer about a faulty phone or a refund?
search_text: What happens when buyers contact the seller or manufacturer about a faulty phone or a refund?

rows.text: Don't buy from this seller. I started having issues with the touch screen after having the phone for 5 weeks. Tried to return, which was refused since it was "out of warranty". See if you can find out the warranty period before purchasing. This purchase was wasted money. Buyer Beware.

Warranty problem! Be careful. I bought it from EZ Deal (Pick 2day Guaranteed). After 6 month it does not work anymore (touch screen does not work well, main home button does not work at all). I contacted the seller who did not help me and did not accept return or refund. Keep in mind that according to APPLE, the manufacture give you only few month of warranty while the seller has to guarantee 2-year warranty. With this seller and Amazon you have only 45 days warranty! So after that time frame (e.g. your iphone breaks 12 months after you buy it) you have not protection from Amazon and you just waste your money. So be careful.

Just okay. This phone was in great cosmetic condition. After about 2 weeks the speaker stopped working and I could not hear anything. The seller was great and issued a refund right away. I was pretty bummed, but I guess that’s the risk with a refurbished phone.

I need a refund or new phone please contact me!!!. The camera is very shaky when trying to take a picture or video unless in slow motion. The data does not work though I can receive and send text messages and phone calls.

I got a new SIM card and the same day, it did it again. So I knew I had to return the phone. When I contacted Amazon again, the rep said she was unable to contact the seller but they would give me a refund. So since I was near an Apple store, I went in to get it checked out and the rep stated that the IPhone 6 & 7's has had this problem and she said Apple can take care of it at no cost. But wait, here is the kicker! When she looked up the serial number to get the Mfg date and software date, it had 1975 or 1971 for both! Really? IPhones weren't even thought of then. Well maybe a thought! So because of that Apple could do nothing to fix the problem. Through it all AMAZON has GREAT CUSTOMER SERVICE!

Make sure you buy a screen protector and a silicone rubber-back case to protect the sides of the phone in case it gets accidentally dropped on the street – which it eventually will. Finally, some one-star reviews posted on amazon are from buyers griping about having been shipped locked or otherwise non-functional phones by online sellers. This must be very frustrating but these are not really product reviews, they are complaints about the seller. One solution is to buy from an Apple store; they’ll set up the new iPhone for you, transfer all your contacts, settings and data from your old phone and be available to resolve any subsequent issues.
Buyer Beware. BUYER BEWARE. I purchased this phone a few days ago, today it was delivered, the problem is that I opened the box and there was NO PHONE INSIDE. Only the charger and the headphones.

Buyer beware. Bought the first phone, it was locked. Returned it and was assured this was a "very rare" occurrence. The reordered phone just arrived, it's locked as well. Buyer beware folks. Fool me once...

Fraud: The seller sold me a tampered product as new.. I bought the phone new from the seller it was packed and sealed in a new box. The phone was a birthday present for my daughter so was not opened to be used until after the return period had expired. the phone worked for 2 weeks and crashed. when i took it to apple for repairs at the apple store i was informed that this was not a new phone and that parts of it had been tampered with so apple could not repair it or even accept it for trade-in.
Buyer Beware!!!. Phone was NOT unlocked! Very difficult to resolve with the seller... still not resolved! My daughter has a phone she cannot use with our carrier! So frustrated!

Faulty. Love the design and a great phone but sometimes the home, power and volume buttons become unresponsive and other times the camera is just completely blank or blurred and I'm unable to take pictures. Also lags here or there. Don't really recommend.

Do Not Buy. Bought this phone a couple months ago and it stopped working. Tried contacting the supplier for help/ support and their response is Expiration of returns period so No help for me. After about 4 months with the phone, it would cycle power until the phone did not want to come on anymore. I would have to use iTunes and restore the phone to factory settings to get it back on. I lost all my contacts, pictures, and other documents which was not on the cloud. I just wanted help in getting the phone fixed.
the phone was frozen. I don't like to give bad reviews, but this phone didn't work out of the box, I will be returning it for a full refund.

Sells JUNK don’t waste your time.. This product quit working after 6 months. Do not waste your time purchasing anything from this seller. When the WiFi button grayed out I took it to the Apple store and they said it was internal. Which more than likely happens because of how they refurbished it. It was not properly refurbished.

I'm very disappointed. It started all good like everything else in .... This phone did not even last a year. I'm very disappointed. It started all good like everything else in life and then the phone came up with an error. checked online and its a RAM failure in the phone. Of course, my not venture is to contact the seller, but don't be surprised I can't get in contact with them. I'm done
I hope the seller will help with this issue. It worked fine until yesterday it froze up and the service center couldn’t get it to work. Also it was from Japan not a United States phone

Something was internally wrong with the phone that was not mentioned.. I did buy this phone used, under the impression that the minimum wear and tear and age of the device were the only things wrong with it. Unfortunately upon receiving the device its screen tears horrifically and the touchscreen is all but responsive. The few times the screen does respond it registers a few millimeters above the point of contact. I had a very quick response when I mentioned this and am currently in the middle of emailing the service. My review will change based on the result of the emailing.
Damaged screen!!. The screen is damaged. I bought a very expensive piece of junk. Beware this seller.
Phone. Got a broken phone
Phone can’t be activated. Phone could not be activated, was not a sprint phone. Now I got to wait for a refund to try and get another phone.
